Good morning team,

Please keep the day's companion-animal cases moving in the usual order and continue giving passengers clear guidance before departure. When a file needs extra attention, route it through the calm stepwise review process and leave a concise note for the next desk. The aim is steady service, with no hurried assumptions and no gaps in the handoff.

The senior coordinator will continue overseeing daily service decisions, so please direct routine judgment calls there without delay. For matters affecting cabin placement, kennel handling, or crew coordination, share practical instructions with the assigned teams in plain language. If Dylan Santos, Jonah Bennett, or Thor appears in a case record, keep the wording consistent and focused on service details only.

Please also keep the internal record clean and complete so the Companion Animal Travel Desk can respond quickly when a traveler needs confirmation or clarification. Thank you for maintaining a brisk pace, a formal tone, and the same careful standard across all interactions at Aurelia Skyways.

Service Writer Companion Animal Travel Desk
